reason: Adds per-model group pricing and an explicit long-context pricing switch while preserving the existing enabled behavior by default.
risk: Adding a NOT NULL column with a default can briefly lock or rewrite the groups table, and the follow-up UPDATE scans existing groups to normalize the flag to true.
mitigation: The change is additive and idempotent, TRUE preserves prior long-context billing semantics, the UPDATE only touches rows that differ, and model_pricing remains nullable until an operator configures overrides.
